notes: Terra Santa Propriedades (LAND3) spun off from Terra Santa Agro in 2021 as B3-listed exclusively-rural-real-estate vehicle. All 7 owned farms in Mato Grosso, leased on 25-yr contract to SLC Agrícola. Annual S&P Global laudo de avaliação (Nov base date).

periods.notes: S&P Global Nov-2022 laudo: R$3,635M = R$92,769/ha = R$37,548/acre (peak after COVID-era soy rally)
S&P Nov-2024: R$2,756M = R$70,310/ha = R$28,455/acre (-7.9% on soybean weakness)
S&P Nov-2025: R$2,796.4M = R$71,344/ha = R$28,872/acre (slight recovery)
